title: Shared ObjectStoreBackend is the right abstraction
description: Extracting the common object_store IpfsStore/IpfsBlockStore logic into ObjectStoreBackend and ObjectStoreBlockBackend is the correct factoring. S3/Azure/GCS backends are genuinely identical except for their auth/builder constructors; sharing the get/put/delete implementation means a correctness fix or codec change (e.g. switching from CIDv1 raw to DAG-CBOR) only happens once. A contributor might suggest inlining the logic back into each backend for 'clarity' — that would be wrong. The abstraction carries its weight.
